vb_textbox.text: I found that the purple gnome was the most consistent for gaining mushrooms there was only a couple of times it didn't award any but keep going with it rather than choosing the other gnome as it is the best one. To start the red one will give mushrooms and will then stop I found once that happened the brown one started being consistent with the mushrooms. It also helps to have your fingers on the keys before starting as it does time out very quickly and you lose out on points if you miss it, also keep your thumbs on the space bar too to help you stay responsive in the quickest time
